messages:
maria: Heads-up — we need to lock the driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix for the marketplace images before the joint announcement next week. Partner legal wants exact pinned versions.

kai: Agreed. Which partners are in scope for the first wave? AWS marketplace + our OEM partner?

maria: Yes — AWS AMI, GCP marketplace, and the OEM marketplace bundle with AcmeAccel. Also need to coordinate with SI kits.

sanjeev: We saw a regression on ROCm 5.6 with kv-cache on longer seqs (INF-2891). If we pin to ROCm 5.5 for now, we avoid the perf cliff. Thoughts?

emily: Pinning to older ROCm is fine but then we need an explicit note in the announcement and a short mitigation roadmap for customers.

noah: From infra side: pin list should include driver, CUDA/cuDNN (for NVIDIA), ROCm, and kernel versions we validated. I'll need the exact combos.

maria: Draft pinned matrix below — please sanity-check and add missing combos. We'll publish this in the marketplace description and in partner release notes.

partners-bot: NOTE: Please add entries to the partner compatibility spreadsheet: https://tiny.redwood/partner-compat-matrix

maria: ```
Pinned versions (initial wave):
- NVIDIA driver: 535.54.03
- CUDA: 12.1
- cuDNN: 8.9.2
- ROCm: 5.5 (avoid 5.6 until INF-2891 fixed)
- Linux kernel: 5.15.x
- Container base: ubuntu:22.04
```

kai: Looks OK. Two asks: (1) can we support a minor CUDA 12.2 variant for dedicated customers? (2) Add canary tests that exercise long-sequence kv-cache paths.

sanjeev: (1) We can add 12.2 as a compatible variant but not as marketplace default. (2) I'll add a canary job that runs the long-seq test suite nightly. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2903

emily: I'll update the marketing copy to call out the default pinned versions and the "compatible variants" section. We should also include rollback guidance.

noah: Rollback plan suggestion: marketplace image tags use semantic suffix: `v1-pinned-202603` and a `v1-compat-12.2` variant. Deploy bot will only flip default tag after staging + 2-day canary.

deploy-bot: deploy note: automatic canary rollout requires successful runs from: staging, regional-canary-us, regional-canary-eu. See infra job: `marketplace-canary-runner`

maria: We also need a hotfix play in case driver regressions are found post-announcement. Proposed steps: 1) open hotfix branch, 2) build quick image with patched driver, 3) coordinate partner patch notes, 4) trigger opt-in canaries for affected customers.

kai: Recommend a pre-approved emergency signoff list (eng lead, infra lead, partnerships PM) so we can move fast.

emily: Marketing will hold the joint announcement date but can add a caveat line about pinned stacks and active testing. Partner marketing needs a one-pager by EOD Friday.

sanjeev: For INF-2891 I have a reproduction and a provisional patch. If we can't land it in time, we'll list ROCm 5.6 as "unsupported" in the marketplace metadata.

maria: OK. Action items: @kai add canary job + test vectors (INF-2903). @sanjeev try hotfix branch for ROCm regression; update INF-2891 by EOD. @emily prepare partner one-pager and announcement caveat. @noah prepare image tagging scheme and rollback runbook. I'll coordinate with partner engineering tomorrow at 10am PT. :calendar: 10am PT meeting invite going out.

partners-bot: Reminder: attach final pinned-matrix to the partner package by Tue COB: https://tiny.redwood/partner-compat-matrix

noah: Noted. I'll also add kernel/driver checks to the preflight so the marketplace validators fail early if mismatch.

maria: Thanks everyone — staying coordinated here will save us a lot of churn. :heavy_check_mark:

deploy-bot: INFO: created ticket INF-2910 (marketplace-image-tagging-and-rollout) and triggered initial canary in staging.
